cac:ProcurementProject.cbc:Name: Rock Placement Germany
cac:ProcurementProject.cbc:Description:
TenneT Germany requires a pool of reliable, trustworthy and highly professional partners to conclude framework agreements with regards to providing Rock Placement / Rock Dumping services in the North Sea for a maximum of 8 years.
Duration of contract: 01.06.2026 until 31.05.2031 (plus three options to extend by 12 months each).
Award criteria: "Technical Capability & Availability" / weighting: 30% "Contract Conditions" / weighting: 20% "Price" / weighting: 50%
Number of candidates invited to participate in the negotiations: 5 The selection of the five candidates to be invited for negotiations after the submission of offers will be based on the above award criteria applied on the documents submitted by the bidders. The evaluation of the subsequently finalized bids for the contract award will also be based on the above award criteria.
In order to protect the confidentiality of the information provided by the client in the tender documents, it is mandatory to conclude a confidentiality Agreement as per "NDA" document provided for download via hereunder. Please send the signed and stamped copy to: claas.drechsler@tennet.eu.
After sending the NDA and a plausibility check by the Client, the Client will grant the interested parties access to the tender by Email. The bidder can not deduce eligibility for participation only from signing and submitting the NDA. TenneT will only accept tenderers who successfully qualify during the call for competition phase to participate in the offer phase. Please note that granting access to the tender through invitation might take up to one or two full working days. Please ensure that the NDA is provided on time allowing you sufficient time to complete the questionnaires in time.
After registering for the tender at Mercell, you will find all tender documents for the "call for competition phase" and the "offer phase" under "Questionnaires", section "Call for Competition", question 1.2.1.
General outline of the tender process: Call for competition phase: general qualification phase during which interested parties submit documents proving the general qualification to conduct the contract.(no price or contract draft required at this moment). Offer phase: During this phase, the qualified parties are eligible to submit their initial offers including contract draft (annotation) , prices and other offer documents requested by TenneT. Negotiations: the 5 most favorable offers are admitted for negotiations during which the contract, prices and technical details are discussed and ideally finalized. BAFO phase: after the negotiations, TenneT grants the bidders a certain timeframe to submit the Best and Final Offer which will form basis of the contract to be closed. Awarding of the framework agreements by TenneT. For exact timelines, see SCHEDULE!
The application for the call for competition must be submitted in due time and no later than by 19.12.2025 at 11:00 CEST via the e-Award platform Mercell Source-to-Contract. Individual extensions of time will not be granted. Please start your upload process early enough and ensure that your application is submitted.
Submission of the request to participate (applications) by Email, mail or fax are not permitted. A violation of this requirement will lead to disqualification of the applicant and exclusion from the tender process.
Please make sure to familiarize yourself with the tender documents, Schedule, Questionnaires, and the tender platform Mercell in general early enough and thoroughly read through all relevant documents.
The Questionnaire for the call for competition phase itself can only be conducted after providing the NDA and registering for this tender. The Questionnaire for the offer phase becomes accessible only after successful completion of the prior call for competition phase. A summary of all questionnaires can be found hereunder.
In case of technical difficulties, please reach out to Mercell: Servicedesk Mercell: support-nl@mercell.com Phone: +31 (0) 85-001 4593 Opening hours: 9:00-17:00 CET

The application documents must be submitted in digital form (in a standardized data format, e.g. PDF and MS Office format) exclusively via the Mercell platform. Pre-submission of application documents by email, fax or mail is not permitted and will lead to disqualification of the applicant and exclusion from the tender process.
*
Requests to participate must be submitted in full by above deadline exclusively via Mercell in the sections provided for this purpose. Please use all forms provided on the Mercell online platform, which must be submitted with the tender application. Tender applications that are submitted late cannot be considered. Incomplete documents may lead to exclusion from the tender.
*
The contracting entity reserves the right to invite a maximum of five (5) candidates to participate in negotiations following the initial evaluation of tenders. The selection of candidates to be invited will be based on the award criteria specified in Section 5.1.10. This limitation serves to ensure an efficient negotiation process while maintaining fair competition among qualified bidders. *
In accordance with § 57 SektVO, the contracting authority is authorised to discontinue the award procedure at any time.
*
The total estimated maximum value of the framework agreement is EUR 24,000,000. This amount represents the overall ceiling, including all call-offs, options and potential extensions. It does not constitute a commitment or guarantee by the contracting entity to award or call off the stated volume, nor does it create any obligation to place call-offs if no needs arise during the contract term. The total value of all call-offs shall not exceed the maximum amount indicated above. The stated amount is provided for transparency purposes only and may not be used as a commercial guideline or expectation for offer pricing.
*
The award of the contract is subject to changes in the legal and/or regulatory framework, rules and regulations in force at the time of publication of this announcement.
*
The exercise of any call-offs under this framework agreement is subject to the proviso that the necessary approvals for the realization of the projects have been obtained or the corresponding projects in the network development plan have been finally confirmed.
*
Companies affiliated with the contracting authority within the meaning of §§ 15 ff. AktG (even if they are only founded after conclusion of the framework agreement). Call-offs under this agreement are made in particular by the contracting authority (TenneT Offshore GmbH) and/or one of its affiliated companies, this is further described in the tender documentation.
*
The Principal is authorised to transfer the rights and obligations of the subject matter of the contract as a whole to a project company (Special Purpose Vehicle/NewCo), irrespective of whether third parties have already participated as shareholders in this project company or will only participate in such a company after any transfer of this Framework Agreement.
*
Technical questions regarding the use of Mercell can be addressed directly to the Mercell ServiceDesk: E-mail: support-nl@mercell.com Telephone: +31 (0)85-001 4593 Availability: 9:00 to 17:00
*
Methodology for the general evaluation of offers and BAFO offers For each criterion - except for the evaluation criterion "price", which will be dealt with separately - a comparative evaluation will be carried out and the bidders will be ranked according to their performance within this criterion. The ranking is then multiplied by the weighting of the respective criterion. The weighted rankings of all criteria are added together. The bidder with the best overall ranking is deemed to be the most economically favourable bidder and will be awarded with the first place.
Price: The price criterion is based on the following evaluation of the bids/offers: The bid with the lowest bid price will be ranked at 1.00. Any bid that exceeds 2 times the lowest bid price will be awarded the last rank, which always corresponds to the number of bids submitted and evaluated. The evaluation of the bid prices which lie in between is carried out by means of linear interpolation with up to two decimal digits. This applies to both, the selection of candidates to conduct the negotiations with (evaluation based on the initial offer documents) as well as the later awarding of the contract to the winning candidate (evaluation based on BAFO documents).
Contractual conditions: The negotiation results within the framework of the award procedure are evaluated with regard to the final distribution of contractual risks to the disadvantage of the TenneT in comparison to TenneT's draft. If there are no specifications from TenneT, the results of the negotiations are assessed comparatively.
Technical Ability & Availability: The results of the negotiations within the framework of the award procedure are evaluated with regard to the final concept submitted by the bidders in terms of the overall service design in all areas required by TenneT. The results of the negotiations are evaluated comparatively.
*
Any applicant or tenderer who considers its rights infringed by non-compliance with public procurement law may lodge a complaint in accordance with Section 160 (3) of the German Act against Restraints of Competition (GWB). Complaints must be raised within the statutory deadlines; in particular, alleged violations must be notified to the contracting entity within 10 days of becoming known and at the latest before the expiry of the tender deadline. After the contracting entity has rejected a complaint, a review application must be filed within 15 days.

efac:SelectionCriteria.cbc:Description: Current extract from the professional or commercial register / company register / partnership register or, in the case of foreign companies, comparable information (not older than 3 months from the date of submission of the application for participation)

Self-declaration on EU sanctions compliance: The tenderer confirms compliance with Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2022/576. The tenderer, its shareholders, subcontractors or suppliers (≥ 10 % of contract value) are not owned, controlled or acting on behalf of Russian persons or entities within the meaning of Art. 5k of the Regulation. False or incomplete declarations may lead to exclusion from the procedure or termination of the contract.

Company organisation and profile: The tenderer shall provide a company presentation describing its organisational structure, available resources and personnel capacities (including the number of full-time employees), the scope of provided services, and locations of offices or branches, including all entities involved in the tender.

Minimum annual turnover: The tenderer shall demonstrate an average annual turnover of at least EUR 4,000,000 for each of the last three financial years, derived from comparable offshore service activities. In the case of consortia, the requirement may be met jointly by all members.

Consortium and reliance on other entities (optional): Tenderers may, at their discretion, submit a joint tender as a consortium. In such case, a lead partner shall be designated, and all members will be jointly and severally liable. Tenderers may also, where necessary, rely on the economic, financial, technical or professional capacities of other entities in accordance with §§ 47–49 SektVO / Art. 63 Directive 2014/25/EU. For each supporting entity, a binding commitment must be submitted confirming that the required resources will be made available. All options are voluntary and may only be used if required to demonstrate the necessary capacity.

Tenderers must hold valid business liability insurance with a minimum coverage of EUR 2,500,000 per claim for property damage, personal injury and consequential loss. All vessels used shall be covered by Hull & Machinery insurance up to full vessel value and by P&I insurance or equivalent with a minimum cover of EUR 25,000,000. Proof of workers’ compensation or employer’s liability insurance must also be provided, or confirmation that such coverage is not legally required. Further details are specified in the tender documents and questionnaires.

Tenderers shall provide at least two (2) relevant reference projects completed within the last five (5) years, demonstrating experience in offshore rock placement or comparable marine construction works (e.g. cable protection, crossing structures, scour protection). Further details and evaluation requirements are set out in the tender documents.

Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) Requirements
The bidder must confirm compliance with the contracting authority’s HSE requirements, which are made available on the tender homepage.
By submitting the request to participate, the bidder acknowledges and accepts the HSE requirements as binding minimum conditions for participation.

cac:PaymentTerms.cbc:Note: See tender documentation. Financial arrangements are part of the contract and the negotiation procedure and therefore cannot be specified at this point.

cac:SpecificTendererRequirement.cbc:Description: Late tenders will not be accepted. However, in accordance with § 51 SektVO and Article 76 of Directive 2014/25/EU, the contracting entity may request the submission, completion or clarification of missing or incomplete information or documents, provided this is compatible with the principles of equal treatment and transparency. If requested by TenneT, the corresponding documents must be submitted by the applicants within a (reasonable) timeframe specified by TenneT. The decision to request further information is at the sole discretion of TenneT.

cac:ContractExecutionRequirement.cbc:Description: In order to protect the confidentiality of the information provided by the client in the tender documents, it is mandatory to conclude a confidentiality Agreement as described above.

cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Name: Price
cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Description: Price consists of maximum vessel day rate, mobilisation and demobilisation fees, costs for rock material, fuel expenses and any other related costs - details as specified in the tender documentation, Annex 3 (Price Sheet).

cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Name: Technical
cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Description: Evaluation of the bidder’s technical capability and proposed methodology for performing rock placement / rock dumping works, including the availability of suitable vessels and equipment, project management and HSE systems, as well as quality and safety standards

cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Name: Contractual conditions
cac:SubordinateAwardingCriterion.cbc:Description: Evaluation of the bidder’s acceptance and consistency with the contracting entity’s draft contract. The assessment will consider the overall alignment, clarity, and balance of the contractual terms proposed by the bidder.

cac:SubsequentProcessTenderRequirement.cbc:Name: buyer-categories
cac:SubsequentProcessTenderRequirement.cbc:Description: The framework agreement may also be used by other companies belonging to the contracting entity’s corporate group, as listed in "Annex 05 - Authorized Call-Off Companies" to the procurement documents.
